items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: I was on Art Blakey's first record date with Andy Kirk, had the band, and it was Billy Daniels' first recording for Decca.

ctx.x: After you had gotten them in there?

Yeah, yeah. Chauncey Olman was our lawyer. He was the only lawyer for black celebrities like Billy Daniels, Pearl Bailey and Teddy and whatnot and his brother had an orchestra who followed us. All of the employees at the Pump Room were surprised that we weren't going to stay on because there was no, you know, no time limit.
